name: Phatthalung (Thailand)

colors.symbolism: the outer bands — a provincial colour
the central band — a provincial colour

description: Horizontal bands of yellow, purple and yellow (1:2:1), the purple band charged with the provincial seal of Phatthalung (Khao Ok Thalu mountain).
history: Used as the official flag of Phatthalung province by the provincial government (changwat). Most Thai provincial flags follow a common formula: the provincial seal (the same seal used on the provincial coat of arms) charged on a single-colour field. The designs are traditional and date back to the formation of modern provincial administration in Thailand.
